title: Finite metric spaces with rationally independent edge lengths are determined up to isometry by their magnitude functions
author: Jun O’Hara
source_version: Published Discrete Analysis2025:13,19pp.;8September2025; DOI10.19086/da.143788; fresh exact arXiv2401.00786v6 PDF byte-matches saved published original
difficulty_reason: The proof extracts generalized-series exponents and coefficients from large-scale magnitude asymptotics, then recovers the primitive edge lengths from the resulting additive monoid. Rational independence separates three-edge walk types through their coefficients. A constructive triangle/open-path reconstruction identifies edge incidence and all metric distances despite the initial loss of vertex labels.
work: The Magnitude Function Determines Generic Finite Metric Spaces
